page.layout: One printed page, title page. Centred lines from top to bottom; a printer's ornament (putti with wreath) below the text; imprint lines below the ornament. Faint show-through of the reverse page is not transcribed. Handwritten page number at top right is not transcribed.

main_text.l: Ad diem 24. Augusti, loco horisq; solito.
